description: Runs bounded, evidence-grounded adversarial reviews with fresh internal subagents, or a user-approved local CLI fallback when internal subagents are unavailable. It freezes the original objective and scope, limits automatic review to an initial round plus one focused closure round, detects scope drift and non-convergence, and restores user control before additional review or repair work.

changes: Expand unavailable-subagent fallback discovery across Claude, Codex, OpenCode, and Pi local agent commands.
Ask the user for another local agent command when no built-in fallback candidate is discovered.
Require verification and explicit approval for any user-recommended agent command before use.
Terminate the review workflow when no verified and approved reviewer is available.
